# The House of Joshi

> The House of Joshi is a sovereign Web3 ecosystem focused on digital ownership, creative projects, multichain tools, and preserving digital heritage.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/): Overview of the House of Joshi ecosystem.
- [About](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/about): The project story, principles, and team.
- [Ecosystem](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/ecosystem): Products and projects across the ecosystem.
- [Whitepaper](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/whitepaper): Protocol vision and ecosystem overview.
- [FAQ](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/faq): Answers to common questions.
- [Security](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/security): Security information and user guidance.

## Products
- [Swap](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/swap): Multichain swap information.
- [NFT Launchpad](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/nft-launchpad): Official NFT launchpad information.
- [Legacy Vault](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/legacy-vault): Digital heritage preservation.
- [Dreamweaver](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/dreamweaver): Creative NFT project.
- [Staking](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/staking): Staking experience information.
- [Treasury / DAO](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/treasury): Governance and treasury plans.
- [Merch Store](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/merch): House of Joshi merchandise.
- [Kids](https://thehouseofjoshi.com/kids): Educational resources for younger audiences.
- [Kingdom Within](https://kingdomwithin.thehouseofjoshi.com/): Scripture geometry and creative exploration.
- [Kaboom](https://kaboom.thehouseofjoshi.com/): House of Joshi project.
- [Joshi Astrals](https://joshiastrals.thehouseofjoshi.com/): House of Joshi project.
- [NFT Marketplace](https://nftmarketplace.thehouseofjoshi.com/): Explore and trade ecosystem NFTs.
